title: Radiation-dose-dependent functional synergisms between ATM, ATR and DNA-PKcs in checkpoint control and resection in G<sub>2</sub>-phase

grounded.evidence_quote: DNA-PKcs acts as a sensor for DSBs through recruitment by Ku that causes its activation6.
ATR is activated by a wide range of genotoxic stresses, owing to its recruitment by ATRIP to extended tracts of ssDNA coated with the ssDNA binding protein complex, replication protein A (RPA)15.
Notable and relevant here is the ATR activation induced at resected DSBs.

ATM activation is further promoted by a C-terminal acetylation induced by DSB-associated chromatin changes exposing the H3K9me3 histone mark that recruits and activates, via shielding from dephosphorylation37, the TIP60/Kat9 acetyltransferase38.
Exposure of 82-6 hTert cells to IR induces DSBs as indicated by the formation of 53BP1 foci and activates ATM:
grounded.location: At low IR doses, the ATM/ATR module is organized as a linear array with ATM upstream and with ATR mainly interfacing with the cell cycle engine through Chk1
